text:
sam: FYI customer (acct 8472) opened a ticket — invoice shows ~4.2k extra tokens for a live SSE chat that they say disconnected mid-response. Dashboard shows ~1.2k. Looks like double-counting on reconnect. :eyes:

maria: thanks — what's the ticket id?

sam: Zendesk #Z-1198. Happened during SSE stream. Client cancel (499) then reconnect. Our ledger has two finalize entries for same logical session.

jess: can you paste sample request/response or logs so we can repro?

sam: snippet from customer logs:

```
event: chunk
data: {"id":"abc123","tokens":420,"final":false}
...
event: end
data: {"id":"abc123","tokens":120,"final":true}
```

Customer disconnected right after the first 'chunk' and then reconnected and resumed — both the partial finalize and resumed finalize got counted.

olga: I pulled ledger. Query results look like:

```
/ledger/consumptions?session=abc123
-> total_tokens: 5420
entries: [finalize: 1200, finalize: 4200]
```

Dashboard aggregation window (per-route view) shows 1200 — so invoice includes both finalizes. That explains the delta.

maria: do we dedupe finalizes by session id today?

olga: current dedupe is (session_id, final_event_id). If a reconnect produces a different final_event_id we treat it as separate. For SSE resume the reliable approach is client set Last-Event-ID / resume_id so server can link. Not all clients do that.

sam: customer confirms their client lib didn't set Last-Event-ID. They aborted and reconnected; server accepted both as separate commits.

jess: short-term mitigation for them? refund/credit?

matt: finance: put invoice Z-1198 on hold, I will review. Suggest credit equal to overlap (tokens that are obviously duplicated).

maria: ops plan — manual credit today + docs update. Long-term: defensive server-side dedupe by (session_id + time-window) or accept explicit X-Redwood-Stream-Resume-Id header to tie resumes.

olga: for eng: repro steps below. I’ll add a unit test to runtime dedupe logic.

Repro steps (eng):
1) POST /v1/streams?stream_id=abc123 -> start SSE.
2) send a partial chunk event and simulate client disconnect.
3) reconnect without Last-Event-ID; server opens a new stream and commits the earlier partial finalize.
4) resume generation -> second finalize recorded.

olga: I created a quick script to reproduce locally (will push to repo):
```
# simulate a client that doesn't set Last-Event-ID
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \"$HOST/v1/streams?stream_id=abc123\" 
# send partial chunk, then close socket
# reconnect: same endpoint but no resume header -> second finalize
```

sam: I'll ask customer if they want invoice adjustment now or wait for fix; they want credits ASAP.

matt: credit issued: provisional credit for overlapping tokens. Will finalize after eng confirms mitigation. Putting a flag on invoice Z-1198.

jess: can we also add better telemetry to billing logs to indicate stream_resume_id / last_event_id so these are easier to reconcile?

olga: agreed — adding stream_resume_id to billing events and ledger entries. That should make post-facto dedupe possible.

maria: owners: @olga (eng-infra) fix + test, @matt (finance) credit & invoice hold, @sam (support) customer comms + collect client logs. ETA: credit + doc today, server dedupe rollout next week.

billing-bot: invoice Z-1198 status: manual_review (assigned:matt) :spiral_calendar:

sam: customer appreciated the quick credit. I'll follow up tomorrow with the AM.

olga: note — also saw edge-case if function-calling triggers multiple final events in same session id; will cover that in tests.

maria: thanks team. I'll file a follow-up postmortem and update the KB article for SSE resume best practices. :white_check_mark:
